name: Aktiv Camping Imst
beschreibung: Aktiv Camping Imst is located in the town of Imst in Tyrol. The campsite provides pitches for RVs, caravans, and tents. The site features a heated swimming pool and sports facilities. Guests can enjoy hiking, biking, and rock climbing in the surrounding area. This campsite is an excellent starting point for an active alpine getaway. The facilities are modern and clean.
